name: Yeseul Seo
affiliation: KAIST · Electrical Engineering & Brain and Cognitive Sciences
headline: From neural principles to intelligent hardware.
bio: I am an undergraduate at KAIST studying electrical engineering and brain and cognitive sciences. My research interests lie at the intersection of neuromorphic devices, neural encoding, and brain-inspired computing.
researchStatement: I am interested in how the physical dynamics of devices can support computation, and how insights from neural systems can guide the design of efficient, adaptive hardware.

projects.title: Hysteretic silicon devices
projects.description: Exploring SOI device dynamics and history-dependent behavior through device simulation, with an interest in vestibular encoding.

projects.title: Neuromorphic vestibular encoding
projects.description: Modeling human vestibular encoding using spiking neurons on the DYNAP-SE neuromorphic platform.

projects.title: Emotion control in language models
projects.description: Investigating the control of emotional trajectories in language-model dialogue through vector steering.
